select distinct bm_weigh_task.id, bm_weigh_task.task_no, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code as material_merge_code, bm_material.specification as material_specification, bm_weigh_centre.name as weigh_centre_name, bm_weigh_centre.code as weigh_centre_code, bm_weigh_task.requirement_quantity, bm_weigh_task.unit_id, bm_weigh_task.execute_date, bm_weigh_task.task_status, (select count(1) = 0 from bm_weigh_requirement where weigh_requirement_task_id = bm_weigh_task.id and requirement_status in (2, 3) and weigh_status != 0) as cancel_able from bm_weigh_task left join bm_material on bm_weigh_task.material_id = bm_material.id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_weigh_centre on bm_weigh_task.weigh_centre_id = bm_weigh_centre.id and bm_weigh_centre.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_resource_permission on bm_weigh_task.weigh_centre_id = bm_resource_permission.resource_id
bm_weigh_task.is_deleted = 0 -- 部门权限
and bm_resource_permission.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and 1 = 0
-- 搜索条件
and bm_weigh_task.task_no like concat('%', #{pageQuery.taskNo}, '%')
and bm_material.name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.materialName}, '%')
and bm_material.merge_code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.materialMergeCode}, '%')
and ((bm_weigh_centre.name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.weighCentre}, '%')) or (bm_weigh_centre.code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.weighCentre}, '%')))
and bm_weigh_task.execute_date between #{pageQuery.executeDateStart} and #{pageQuery.executeDateEnd}
order by bm_weigh_task.id desc

select distinct bm_weigh_task.id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code as material_merge_code, bm_material.specification as material_specification, bm_weigh_centre.code as weigh_centre_code, bm_weigh_centre.name as weigh_centre_name, bm_weigh_task.finish_time as finish_time, bm_weigh_task.task_no, bm_weigh_task.send_time, bm_weigh_task.execute_date from bm_weigh_task left join bm_material on bm_weigh_task.material_id = bm_material.id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_weigh_centre on bm_weigh_task.weigh_centre_id = bm_weigh_centre.id and bm_weigh_centre.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_resource_permission on bm_weigh_task.weigh_centre_id = bm_resource_permission.resource_id left join bm_weigh_centre_station on bm_weigh_task.weigh_centre_id = bm_weigh_centre_station.weigh_centre_id left join (select count(1) != 0 as active, weigh_requirement_task_id from bm_weigh_requirement where bm_weigh_requirement.is_deleted = 0 and weigh_requirement_task_id is not null and ((requirement_status = 1 and expired_date >= date(now())) or requirement_status = 2 or (requirement_status = 3 and weigh_process in (3,4))) group by weigh_requirement_task_id) req on req.weigh_requirement_task_id = bm_weigh_task.id
bm_weigh_task.is_deleted = 0
-- 只查询已下发的 and bm_weigh_task.task_status = 2 -- 只查询带有已下发的且未称量未过期或称量中的需求的任务 and req.active = true
-- 只查询已完成的 and bm_weigh_task.task_status = 3
-- 部门权限
and bm_resource_permission.dept_id in
#{deptId}
and 1 = 0
-- 工位权限
and bm_weigh_centre_station.station_id in
#{stationId}
and 1 = 0
-- 搜索条件
and bm_weigh_task.task_no like concat('%', #{pageQuery.taskNo}, '%')
and (bm_material.name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.material}, '%') or bm_material.merge_code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.material}, '%'))
and (bm_weigh_centre.name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.weighCentre}, '%') or bm_weigh_centre.code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.weighCentre}, '%'))
order by bm_weigh_task.send_time desc

select bm_weigh_task.id, bm_weigh_task.material_id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code as material_merge_code, bm_weigh_task.weigh_centre_id, bm_weigh_centre.name as weigh_centre_name, bm_weigh_centre.code as weigh_centre_code, bm_weigh_task.requirement_quantity, bm_weigh_task.unit_id, bm_weigh_task.storage_material_batch_id from bm_weigh_task left join bm_material on bm_weigh_task.material_id = bm_material.id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_weigh_centre on bm_weigh_task.weigh_centre_id = bm_weigh_centre.id and bm_weigh_centre.is_deleted = 0 where bm_weigh_task.is_deleted = 0 and bm_weigh_task.id = #{taskId}
